note: words_unique_deposit_level is THE figure to quote. It pools every redacted column, deduplicates exact repeats, and drops any passage that is a substring of a longer passage from the same source document. words_row_sum counts the same passage once per row it appears in. words_unique_within_column_sum deduplicates inside each column but is NOT additive across columns, because actor_claims_long.source_statement contains supporting_passage for the same claim; summing the per-column figures therefore double-counts that overlap.
